blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Editing multi-camera concerts requires coordinated decisions about musical relevance, visual quality and cut timing. We present a modular framework that combines instrument activity from multitrack audio, visible instruments and image sharpness with beat-based timing and probabilistic camera selection. An interpretable scoring model links these components to the choice of views over complete shot intervals. Component tests and an exploratory expert study on a four-camera concert yield mixed assessments across the editing variants. The findings motivate extending local audiovisual relevance with contextual and sequence-level criteria. The architecture provides a basis for testing these extensions and studying how component behaviour affects the quality of complete edits.
blocks.zh: 编辑多相机演唱会需要对音乐的相关性,视觉质量和剪接时间做出协调的决定. 我们提出了一个模块框架,将多轨道音频、可见仪器和图像锐度的仪器活动与基于节拍的计时和概率相机选择结合起来。 一个可解释的评分模型将这些组件与在完全相距上选择视图联系起来. 关于四相机音乐会的组成部分测试和探索性专家研究在编辑变体中得出了混合评估。 这些调查结果促使人们根据背景和顺序标准,扩大地方视听的相关性。 该架构为测试这些扩展并研究组件行为如何影响完整编辑的质量提供了基础.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Multi-camera concert editing requires deciding when to cut and which view to show. Editors coordinate musical activity, image quality, framing and the progression of a sequence. A clear view of an active instrument can be useful, but so can a reaction or an interaction elsewhere in the ensemble. Automating this workflow therefore requires more than ranking isolated images.

blocks.en: Automatic camera management has been studied in lecture environments [ 9 ] , concert mashups [ 15 ] and social-camera footage [ 1 ] . Concert-directing systems combine auditory and visual instrument information [ 17 ] ; learned approaches address next-view selection and cut prediction [ 8 , 6 ] . Temporal and candidate-view context are also modelled in multi-camera editing [ 12 , 2 ] , while theatre systems combine camera selection and shot-size control [ 16 ] .
blocks.zh: 自动相机管理已经在讲座环境[9],音乐会mashups[15]和社交相机镜头中被研究过. [一]. 音乐会引导系统结合了听觉和视觉仪表信息[17];学到的方法解决了后视选择和剪切预测[8,6]. Temperal和候选人-观点背景也模仿多相机编辑[12,2],而剧场系统结合相机选择和相机大小控制[16].

blocks.en: We present a modular framework that separates audio analysis, visual analysis, camera scoring and temporal selection. Named audio stems provide instrument activity and roles; visual detections describe instrument visibility, and image-gradient statistics characterise sharpness. An explicit utility combines these signals, aggregates them over a prospective shot interval and controls a probabilistic camera selector. Beat and tempo estimates determine candidate cut boundaries independently of view selection.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了一个模块框架,将音频分析、视觉分析、相机评分和时间选择分开。 被命名的音频源提供仪器活性和作用;视觉检测描述出仪器能见度,而图像梯度统计特征为锐度. 一种明确的工具结合这些信号,将它们聚合到一个可能的相机间隔上,并控制一个概率相机选择器. 节奏和节奏估计与视图选择无关,确定候选人的界限。

blocks.en: The contributions are threefold: a transparent multimodal architecture for concert editing; an explicit mapping from role and quality cues to interval-level camera choices; and a component and expert evaluation that motivates targeted architectural extensions. The study compares a human reference, random camera selection and two score-driven variants. Its mixed results inform further work on shot suitability, contextual reactions and sequence structure without treating component accuracy as a substitute for complete-edit quality.
blocks.zh: 这些贡献有三个方面:用于音乐会编辑的透明多模式架构;从角色和质量提示到相隔相机选择的明确绘图;以及激励目标建筑扩展的部分和专家评价。 该研究比较了人类参考,随机相机选择和两个分数驱动的变体. 它的好坏参半的结果为关于镜头适合性、上下文反应和序列结构的进一步工作提供了参考,但没有将组件精度作为完全编辑质量的替代品。

blocks.en: 2 Related work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Wang et al. [ 17 ] provide a close comparison to the explicit-score design: their system already combines audible–visible instrument matching, blur and shot-scale information. Table 1 compares the audio inputs, scoring, timing and selection mechanisms.
blocks.zh: 王等编. [17] 提供了与明确分数设计的相近比较:他们的系统已经结合了可听取的-可见的仪器相匹配,模糊和相片尺度的信息. 表1比较了音频输入、评分、时间安排和选择机制。

blocks.en: Table 1: Concert-directing comparison with Wang et al. (2023). The table compares system designs rather than performance on a common dataset.
blocks.zh: 表1:音乐会指挥与王等(2023)的比较. 该表比较了系统设计而不是在共同数据集上的性能.

blocks.en: Shrestha et al. [ 15 ] combine perceptual image quality, content diversity and cut-point suitability in concert mashups. Their 40-participant evaluation already compares automatic, manual and random edits, so our baseline follows an established strategy. Daniyal and Cavallaro [ 3 ] model finite-horizon camera scheduling with content quality and switching costs; our no-repeat sampler does not optimise a sequence-level objective. Stoll et al. [ 16 ] combine rule-based camera selection and cropping for four-perspective theatre recording, including audiovisual speaker assignment. Their comparison of four-perspective and single-perspective edited versions holds cut times, shot lengths and shot sizes fixed. Our system selects existing views without generating tighter framing.
blocks.zh: Shrestha 等 [15] 结合了视觉图像质量,内容多样性和音乐会泥浆中切分的合适性. 他们的40个参与评价已经比较了自动,人工和随机编辑,所以我们的基线遵循既定的战略. Daniyal和Cavallaro[3]型号有限-视距相机排程,内容质量和切换成本;我们的不重复采样器不优化序列级目标. 斯多尔等. [16] 结合了基于规则的相机选择和裁剪,用于四视角的剧场录音,包括视听演讲者任务. 他们比较了四相相和单相相被编辑的版本,持有剪接时间,射击长度和固定镜头尺寸. 我们的系统在选择现有视图时不产生更严格的框架。

blocks.en: Learned concert-editing approaches are also direct comparators. Jiménez et al. [ 8 ] learn visual next-shot selection from professionally edited concert videos. Their human study assesses static image choices. Learned next-view selection is therefore an established approach. Gonzálbez-Biosca et al. [ 6 ] separate cut-time prediction from view selection: audio and temporal features inform the former, and learned visual representations inform the latter. Their classical-concert evaluation uses pseudo-labelled candidates derived from existing edits and reports cut-prediction and retrieval measures. These are different outcomes from perceived quality of a complete realised edit.
blocks.zh: 学习的合唱编辑方法也是直接参照。 希门尼斯等. [8] 从专业编辑的音乐会视频中学习视觉下个镜头选择. 他们的人类研究评估了静态图像选择. 因此,吸取的后一种观点选择是一种既定办法。 Gonzálbez-Biosca 等人著. [6] 将剪接时间预测与取景选择分开:音频和时间特征告知前者,所学视觉表现告知后者. 他们的古典音乐会评价使用从现有的编辑和报告剪切预测和检索措施中衍生出来的被作假标记的候选人. 这些是完全实现的编辑的预期质量所产生的不同结果。

blocks.en: Rao et al. [ 12 ] introduce the TVMCE benchmark with synchronised multi-camera material including concerts and model both past frames and candidate views. Cabacas-Maso et al. [ 2 ] further distinguish history and candidate encoding through a dual-transformer architecture with cross-attention. Such approaches explicitly represent context beyond our no-repeat sampler, but their reference-decision agreement measures do not by themselves establish perceptual quality of our concert edits.
blocks.zh: 拉奥等. [12] 采用TVMCE基准,采用同步多相机材料,包括音乐会和模式,既包括过去的框架,也包括候选观点. 卡巴卡斯-马索等. [2]通过有交叉意向的双向转换架构,进一步区分历史和候选编码. 这种方法明确代表了我们不重复的取样人以外的背景,但其参考决定协议措施本身并不能确定我们音乐会编辑的观念质量。

blocks.en: Adjacent editorial approaches make broader objectives explicit. Galvane et al. [ 4 ] optimise shot sequences in 3D animation using action, continuity and rhythm costs, with subjective comparisons of degraded cost variants. EditIQ [ 5 ] combines dialogue interpretation, saliency and speaker cues with cinematic constraints for virtual views from wide-angle recordings; its user study includes emotions and reactions. EmotionCast [ 18 ] additionally studies affective cues in stage-program directing. These works motivate testing editorial context and sequence-level criteria, while their different materials and designs prevent transferring their performance claims to this pilot. The concert evaluation motivates testing these ideas for instrumental performance and ensemble interaction.
blocks.zh: 相邻的编辑方法明确了更广泛的目标。 加尔万等. [4]在3D动画中利用动作,连续性和节奏成本来优化镜头序列,同时对退化成本变体进行主观比较. EditIQ [5] 结合了对话的诠释,突出和扬声提示与影院限制从广角录音中获取虚拟观点;其用户研究包括了情绪和反应. 情感卡斯特[18]在舞台节目指导中额外研究了有影响提示. 这些作品激励测试编辑上下文和序列级标准,而其不同的材料和设计阻止了将其性能诉求转移给这个试点. 音乐会评价激励测试这些想法,以进行器械性能和综艺互动.

blocks.en: The emphasis of our framework is an explicit, modular connection between instrument roles, quality cues, shot timing and camera choice. Component measurements and complete-edit assessment provide complementary views of this design.
blocks.zh: 我们框架的重点是仪器作用、质量提示、拍摄时间和相机选择之间的明确、模块化联系。 组件测量和完整编辑评估对这一设计提供了补充看法。

blocks.en: 3 System overview and material
blocks.zh: 3 系统概况和材料

blocks.en: The framework takes four synchronised camera streams and concert audio as input. Audio processing has two complementary branches: named instrument stems supply activity and audible roles, while their mono mix supplies beat and tempo estimates. The visual branch uses a pretrained D-FINE object detector with retained instrument categories from Objects365 [ 11 , 14 ] and image-gradient statistics for sharpness. These signals feed the camera utility, while the timing branch defines intervals over which views are evaluated. Figure 1 gives the complete processing flow.
blocks.zh: 框架以四个同步相机流和音乐会音频作为输入. 音频处理有两个互补的分支:被命名的乐器源出供应活性与可听出的角色,而其单相混合的供给节拍和节奏估计. 视觉分支使用预先训练的D-FINE天体探测器,从Objects365[11,14]中保留了仪器类别,并使用图像分级统计来表示锐度. 这些信号为相机的公用设备提供素材,而计时分支则规定了评价视图的间隔. 图1给出了完整的处理流程.

blocks.en: Figure 1: Modular concert-editing architecture. Named stems supply activity analysis and are mixed into a mono waveform for timing. Visual roles and sharpness combine with audible roles in a camera utility; shot boundaries define the aggregation intervals. Camera selection produces the edit. Reference annotations form an alternative label input for the annotation-driven evaluation variant.
blocks.zh: 图1:模块音乐会-编辑架构. 被命名为树干供应活性分析,并被混合为一个单波形来进行定时. 视觉角色和锐利与相机工具中的可听角色结合;镜头边界定义了聚合间隔. 相机选择生成编辑 。 参考说明为注释驱动的评价变体构成替代标签输入.

blocks.en: The evaluation uses a recording of the Uli Gutscher Quartet performing at JAZZclub IN DER MITTE e.V. in Reutlingen on 11 January 2025. The camera arrangement comprises an audience-oriented view, two close-up views and a wide view (Table 2 ). Component measurements cover the first 480 s; the expert study uses four complete edits of approximately 7 min 48 s. The annotated audio vocabulary comprises Bass, Drums, Guitar, Piano, Speech and Trombone. Labels describe audible and visible roles, blur and, for the annotation-driven variant, additional pan and clapping cues.

blocks.en: The prediction-driven variant combines estimated audio roles, visible roles and blur. The annotation-driven variant replaces these inputs with reference labels and also includes pan/clapping cues. It therefore tests annotation-driven camera scoring, rather than a detector-only substitution. Detailed algorithms and parameters are given in Appendix A .
blocks.zh: 预测驱动的变体结合了估计的音频角色,可见的角色和模糊. 注释驱动的变体用参考标签来取代这些输入并包括泛/相拍提示. 因此,它测试的是注释驱动相机分数,而不是检测器唯一的替代. 详细的算法和参数见附录A。

blocks.en: 4 Camera scoring and selection
blocks.zh: 4个相机评分和选择

blocks.en: The system translates audible and visible instrument roles into per-second camera utilities, combines them with image quality and aggregates them over each candidate shot. The selection module samples one camera per interval while preventing immediate camera repetition.
blocks.zh: 该系统将可听取和可见的仪器作用转化为每秒相机公用设备,将其与图像质量相结合,并在每个候选镜头上进行聚合. 选择模块对每相机进行取样,同时防止相机立即重复。

blocks.en: 5 Component performance
blocks.zh: 5 构成部分执行情况

blocks.en: Audio-role estimation reaches support-weighted F1 scores of 0.654 for primary and 0.601 for secondary roles. Performance varies across instruments, and blur classification is strongly camera-dependent. These differences affect how the corresponding cues can guide camera choice. Appendix B reports the per-class audio and blur results, sampling definitions, role timelines and camera-score plots.

blocks.en: 6 Expert evaluation
blocks.zh: 6个 专家评价

blocks.en: 6.1 Study design
blocks.zh: 6.1 研究设计

blocks.en: Four edits of the same recording are compared: V1 is a student-produced human reference under expert supervision; V2 uses random camera selection with beat-based timing; V3 uses predicted camera scores; and V4 uses annotation-driven scores. Three experts from different media fields assessed the complete versions without being told the editing method.
blocks.zh: 比较了同名录音的4个编辑: V1是在专家监督下由学生制作的人类参考;V2使用随机相机选择并基于拍取时间;V3使用预测相机分数;而V4使用注释驱动分数. 来自不同媒体领域的三位专家在未被告知编辑方法的情况下对完整版本进行了评估.

blocks.en: The questionnaire requests an overall publication/broadcast-readiness grade and detail ratings for cut timing, transitions, picture quality/sharpness and coherence/aesthetic impression, together with free-text comments. Overall grades use 1 = very good and 5 = poor. Conflicting direction anchors make the detail scales ambiguous, so only the overall grades are interpreted directionally; the detail responses are reported without reversal in Appendix E . Appendix D describes the questionnaire dimensions.

blocks.en: 6.2 Cut timing and shot durations
blocks.zh: 6.2 请检查date=中的日期值 (帮助) 缩短时间和拍摄时间

blocks.en: The four edits use the same audio. V1 contains 35 internal camera changes; V2–V4 each contain 65. Corresponding automatic cut boundaries differ by at most one frame: V3 and V4 coincide, while V2 is one frame earlier. Thus the automatic variants have effectively the same pacing, allowing their view choices to be compared at similar cut timing.

blocks.en: The clip comprises an opening announcement, music and final applause. We use approximate windows of 0–80 s, 80–460 s and 460–467.7 s. Table 3 reports the duration of displayed segments over the full clip and the music window. Shots crossing a window boundary are clipped for the summary, without counting an additional camera change. Appendix C gives the definitions and additional phase summaries.

Cuts are internal camera changes in the window; n n is the number of positive displayed segments, including clipped boundary segments. SD is the sample SD, not uncertainty across concerts. V2–V4 are listed separately, not pooled.

blocks.en: V1 begins with an uninterrupted 116.72-s shot, giving longer and more variable durations than the automatic edits. In the music window its mean is 10.86 s, compared with 6.79 s for V2–V4. The automatic versions also make nine cuts during the announcement, whereas V1 makes none. These statistics describe pacing; musical and editorial fit are assessed separately in the expert feedback.
blocks.zh: V1以不间断的116.72-s镜头开始,给出比自动编辑时间更长和多变的时间. 在音乐窗口中,它的平均值为10.86 s,而V2–V4的平均值为6.79 s. 自动版本在宣布期间也做了9个剪接,而V1则没有. 这些统计数字描述了速度;在专家反馈中分别评估音乐和编辑是否合适。

blocks.en: 6.3 Overall grades
blocks.zh: 第6.3条 总职等

blocks.en: Table 4: Complete overall grades, 1 = very good and 5 = poor. Mean, median and sample SD summarise three ordinal responses descriptively; they do not estimate uncertainty across concerts.
blocks.zh: 表4:全部职等,1个=非常好,5个=贫穷。 平均、中位和样本SD以描述方式概括了三种正统反应;它们并不估计整个音乐会的不确定性。

blocks.en: The assessments are mixed across experts and variants. V1 receives consistent overall grades, while V2 and V4 show greater disagreement. All three experts grade V3 less favourably than V2. V4 improves on V3 for two experts and ties it for the third, but does not receive a better grade than V2. In this recording, score-driven selection therefore provides no overall advantage over the random baseline. The individual grades remain important: equal grades do not necessarily express equal preference, as E3 explicitly prefers V2 despite giving V2 and V4 the same grade.
blocks.zh: 这些评估有不同的专家和变量。 V1获得一致的整体级别,而V2和V4表现出更大的分歧. 所有三位专家的V3等级均不及V2等级. V4为两位专家改进了V3,并与第三名专家建立了联系,但并没有获得比V2更好的分级. 因此,在这一记录中,以分数为驱动的选择比随机基准没有总体优势。 个人的分数仍然很重要:同等分数不一定表达出同等的偏好,因为E3明确倾向于V2,尽管给V2和V4的分数相同.

blocks.en: 6.4 Written feedback
blocks.zh: 6.4 书面反馈

blocks.en: The free-text responses are grouped descriptively by editorial theme. Table 5 retains positive, critical and differing assessments rather than reducing them to a single consensus. The analysis concerns the experts’ expressed judgements; it does not assign an internal technical cause to each reported shot. Appendix F describes the grouping procedure.
blocks.zh: 自由文本的答复按编辑主题分类。 表5保留了积极、关键和不同的评估,而不是将其简化为单一共识。 分析涉及专家表达的判断;它没有为每一次报告的射击指定内部技术原因。 附 录 F描述了分组程序。

blocks.zh: 表5:专家书面反馈中的主题。 定位器确定专家,视频和评论领域.

blocks.en: The feedback highlights a distinction between technically usable images and editorially useful moments. It also values reactions and band interaction alongside the currently prominent instrument. Criticism of incidental audience views coexists with praise for motivated reactions, so the comments do not support a general audience-view prohibition.
blocks.zh: 反馈突出了技术可用图像与编辑有用时间之间的区别。 它还重视反应和波段相互作用以及目前突出的仪器。 对偶然观众观点的批评与对动机反应的赞誉并存,因此评论不支持一般的观众-观点禁令.

blocks.en: 7 Discussion
blocks.zh: 7 讨论情况

blocks.en: 7.1 Relating system components to editorial assessment
blocks.zh: 7.1 与编辑评估有关的系统组成部分

blocks.en: The evaluation relates component-label agreement, temporal characteristics and expert assessment of the complete sequence. The automatic variants share effectively the same measured boundaries, while their overall grades and reported view choices differ. This narrows the interpretation towards camera selection, cue content and sequence behaviour; it does not identify a single causal component. V4’s improvement on V3 for two raters also cannot isolate recognition accuracy, because annotation source, available cues and potentially random draws change together.
blocks.zh: 评价涉及组成部分标签协议、时间特征和对完整序列的专家评估。 自动变体有效共享相同的被测量的界限,而它们的总体等级和报告的观点选择则不同. 这缩小了对相机选择、提示内容和顺序行为的解释;它没有识别一个单一的因果成分。 V4对两个评分器的V3的改进也无法孤立识别精度,因为注释来源,可用的提示和潜在的随机抽取变化在一起.

blocks.en: The feedback specifies what a useful view means to these raters: coverage of musical action, acceptable framing and moments, and motivated reactions or ensemble interaction. These criteria span different architectural interfaces. Table 6 links the reported concerns to operations that can influence selection and to changes that can be tested. The feedback motivates each link; it does not show that the named operation caused a particular shot.
blocks.zh: 反馈具体说明了对这些评价者有用的观点的含义:对音乐动作的覆盖,可接受的框架和瞬间,以及积极的反应或共同互动。 这些标准跨越了不同的建筑界面. 表6将所报告的关切与可能影响选择的行动和可以测试的变化联系起来。 反馈激发出每个链接;它没有显示命名的操作导致特定镜头.

blocks.en: 7.2 Tracing component outputs into camera choices
blocks.zh: 7.2 将追踪部分产出纳入相机选择

blocks.en: Table 6: Component-to-evaluation links and proposed architectural tests. Operational consequences follow from the scoring and selection rules; feedback locators identify reported outcomes. Proposed improvements have not been evaluated.
blocks.zh: 表6:构成部分与评价的联系和拟议的建筑测试。 业务后果来自评分和选择规则;反馈定位器确定报告的结果。 拟议的改进尚未评估。

blocks.en: An important example is the difference between measurement error and operational influence. CAM1’s partial/not-blurred disagreement produces poor classification metrics, but both states have Q c = 1 Q_{c}=1 . Correcting only that disagreement therefore leaves its score unchanged. It cannot, by itself, explain audience-view selection. By contrast, audible-role changes enter both bonuses and penalties, and full-blur or recognised pan labels can zero a per-second score. Even then, the interval aggregate, previous camera and fallback determine whether a score change reaches a displayed view. Appendix G gives conditional score examples and controlled comparisons for studying these effects.
blocks.zh: 一个重要的例子是测量误差与操作影响之间的区别. CAM1的部分/非模糊的分歧导致分类度量差,但两个州都有Q c = 1 Q_{ C}= 1. 因此,仅纠正这一分歧,其得分保持不变。 它本身不能解释观众选择。 相形之下,可听-作用变化同时输入奖金和罚单,而全蓝或被认可的泛标签可以每秒0分. 即便如此,间隔聚合,前相机和倒置也决定了分数变化是否达到显示的视图. 附 录 G为研究这些效果提供有条件的分数示例和可控比较.

blocks.en: The objective also omits some distinctions the comments make. A large, sharp view of a relevant instrument need not show a suitable action, and a valuable reaction need not depict the leading instrument. Adding a larger instrument bonus would not resolve that representational issue. At the same time, neither audience presence nor a non-leading musician is inherently unsuitable: E3’s positive reaction feedback argues for contextual assessment rather than a blanket penalty. Source coverage must be inspected separately, since selection cannot create an unavailable close-up.
blocks.zh: 目标还省略了评论中的一些区别。 对一项相关文书的大而尖锐的看法不必显示适当的行动,有价值的反应不必描绘出主要的文书。 增加更大的仪器奖金并不能解决这一代表性问题。 同时,无论是观众在场还是非领跑乐手,都本质上都不合适: E3的正面反应反馈认为应该进行背景评估,而不是一概惩罚。 必须单独检查源的覆盖范围,因为选择不能产生无法使用的特写。

blocks.en: 7.3 Proposed controlled comparisons
blocks.zh: 7.3 拟议控制下比较

blocks.en: A useful next version would expose separate interfaces for cue availability and reliability, candidate eligibility, musical/contextual relevance, and the sequence policy. Timing would receive an explicit speech/performance/applause state. This factorisation makes it possible to ask whether a recognised property is accurate, whether it changes the utility as intended, and whether the resulting views improve the relevant editorial judgement. It also makes disagreement informative: reaction value and pace preference can be reported per rater rather than hidden in one mean.
blocks.zh: 下一个有用的版本将暴露出单独的接口,用于提示可用性和可靠性、候选人资格、音乐/文字相关性以及序列政策。 时间安排将得到明确的演讲/表现/鼓掌状态。 这种要素化使得人们可以询问一个公认的财产是否准确,它是否按照预期改变效用,以及由此产生的观点是否改善了相关的编辑判断. 这也使分歧变得信息化:反应值和速度偏好可以逐个报出,而不是隐藏在一个平均值中.

blocks.en: Comparison 1: separating suitability and relevance. At common decision opportunities and with unchanged remaining inputs, an initial comparison could add independently annotated eligibility information to the existing selector; a separate comparison could test contextual reaction value. Outcomes would include unsuitable-view exposure, musical-action coverage and paired sequence preference, with any changes in realised cuts caused by eligibility exceptions reported explicitly. This would first test the editorial criterion before introducing prediction error from a new detector. Action-aware and reaction-sensitive objectives have precedents in other settings [ 4 , 5 , 18 ] ; their value for this concert remains to be measured.
blocks.zh: 比较1:区分适用性和相关性。 在共同决策机会和不变的剩余投入下,初步比较可以将独立附加说明的资格信息添加到现有的选择器中;单独比较可以测试上下文的反应值. 结果将包括不适当的视线曝光、音乐动作覆盖面和对序偏好,同时明确报告资格例外导致实际削减的任何变化。 这将首先测试编辑标准,然后从新的探测器中引入预测错误。 行动意识和反应敏感目标在其他场合有先例[4,5,18];它们对这次音乐会的价值仍有待衡量.

blocks.en: Comparison 2: adding sequence context. A controlled comparison would hold local scores and timing fixed, retain the same no-repeat and fallback rules, and compare selection with and without one prespecified history/transition term, such as recently shown performers or view roles. An inspectable rule would avoid initially requiring a larger learned model. Temporal-context systems [ 12 , 2 ] and learned concert selection [ 8 , 6 ] offer later comparison models. Several prespecified realisations and blinded sequence judgements are needed; reference-decision agreement alone is insufficient.
blocks.zh: 比较2:添加序列上下文. 对照比较可以固定本地的分数和计时,保留同样的不重复和倒置规则,并将选择与和没有预先规定的历史/过渡术语进行比较,例如最近显示的表演者或取景角色。 可检查的规则可以避免最初需要更大的学习模式。 Temperal-context systems [12,2] 和学习音乐会选择 [8,6] 提供了后期的比较模型. 需要预先确定一些成就和盲从的顺序判断;仅凭参考决定协议是不够的。

blocks.en: Comparison 3: making quality and fallback operationally explicit. Quality could first be calibrated on development material with supported classes per camera, followed by independent tests of the quality-to-utility map and fallback policy. This comparison would distinguish a hard eligibility constraint from a soft preference. If only the current view is usable, holding it may be preferable to a mandatory switch; if no view is eligible, the interval could be flagged or an explicitly documented exception invoked. Such holds change realised cuts and dwell times, so common decision opportunities do not imply matched realised pacing. The pilot motivates these tests but establishes no improvement from them.
blocks.zh: 比较3:在业务上明确质量和退步。 质量可首先根据每台相机辅助的分级的开发材料进行校正,然后对质量与实用性图和倒置政策进行独立测试。 这种比较将区分硬资格限制和软优惠。 如果只能使用当前视图,持有该视图可能比强制开关更为可取;如果没有视图合格,则可以标出间隔,或者引用明确记载的例外. 这种变化阻碍实现削减和延长时间,因此,共同决策机会并不意味着实现的速度。 试点推动这些测试,但并没有改进。

blocks.en: Phase-specific timing is a complementary extension. Speech/content boundaries should be assessed during announcements, and beat/downbeat or phrase cues during music. Its effect requires a separate timing comparison. The approximately 80-s announcement and the different rhythm judgements show why a full-clip grade and a music-window duration summary answer different questions. A consistent cue vocabulary is also necessary before changing predicted to reference labels; pan/clapping extensions must remain separate factors.
blocks.zh: 具体阶段的时间是补充性的延长。 发言/内容的界限应在宣布时加以评估,在音乐期间加以敲打/打倒或作词提示。 它的效果需要单独的时间比较. 大约80-s的公告和不同的节奏判断显示,为什么一个全clip分级和音乐-窗口持续时间摘要会回答不同的问题. 在改变预测的参考标签之前,还必须有一个一致的提示词汇;泛/相拍扩展必须仍然是单独的因素。

blocks.en: 7.4 Study scope
blocks.zh: 7.4 研究范围

blocks.en: The evaluation covers one concert, one camera arrangement, one realisation per automatic method and three experts. It therefore characterises this application rather than establishing a general ranking of editing strategies. Further concerts, repeated random realisations and a broader expert or audience study are needed to assess transfer across material and preferences.
blocks.zh: 评估范围包括1个音乐会、1个相机安排、每个自动方法1个实现和3个专家。 因此,它将本应用程序的特征化,而不是确定编辑策略的一般排名。 需要进一步的音乐会、重复的随机实现以及更广泛的专家或受众研究,以评估跨材料和偏好转移的情况。

blocks.en: 8 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 8 结论

blocks.en: The framework combines audio and visual analysis, explicit camera scoring, beat-based timing and probabilistic selection in a modular editing system. With effectively matched automatic timing, the prediction-driven edit receives a less favourable overall grade than the available random edit from all three raters. The annotation-driven edit improves on predictions for two raters without receiving a better grade than random selection. The result motivates further development of the selection objective and policy.
blocks.zh: 框架结合了音频和视觉分析,清晰相机评分,节拍计时和模块化编辑系统中的概率选择. 通过有效匹配自动计时,预测驱动编辑的总体级别比所有三个评分器的可选随机编辑要差. 注释驱动的编辑改进了对两个评分器的预测,没有获得比随机选择更好的分级. 结果促使进一步制定甄选目标和政策。

blocks.en: The component results and expert feedback support a research agenda that extends beyond detector accuracy. The findings motivate testing musical relevance, suitable moments, framing and motivated reactions as distinct factors; quality labels need a defined operational effect, and eligibility, aggregation and sequence context should be independently testable. The component-to-evaluation mapping connects the scoring rules to concrete directions for controlled comparison. A follow-up can therefore investigate how changes propagate from labels to scores, selected views and complete-edit judgement, while retaining both favourable and critical observations.
blocks.zh: 构成部分结果和专家反馈支持一项超出探测器准确性的研究议程。 调查结果促使检验音乐的相关性、适当的瞬间、框架和动机的反应作为不同的因素;质量标签需要确定操作效果,资格、汇总和顺序背景应当可以独立检验。 从组成部分到评价的绘图将评分规则与具体方向联系起来,以便进行有控制的比较。 因此,后续行动可以调查从标签到分数、选定观点和完全编辑判断的改变,同时保留有利和批评的意见。

blocks.en: A.1 Beat grid and target shot duration
blocks.zh: A.1 国家 击出网格和目标射击持续时间

blocks.en: The named audio stems are mixed to form the timing waveform, which is loaded as mono at its existing sampling rate using librosa [ 10 ] . If the WAV file is absent, the cutter extracts a 48 kHz stereo PCM waveform from CAM4 and then loads it as mono. The beat tracker returns times ℬ = { b 0 , b 1 , … } \mathcal{B}=\{b_{0},b_{1},\ldots\} . We construct an approximate bar grid 𝒟 = { b 0 , b 4 , b 8 , … } . \mathcal{D}=\{b_{0},b_{4},b_{8},\ldots\}. blocks.en: An example illustrates how a change in a visibility label can affect camera scoring and selection. All other labels and the quality state remain fixed. For an audible label that is primary only, changing its visibility from absent in both visible-role sets to visually primary adds the primary–primary bonus of 4 and removes the missing-primary penalty of 0.9. The per-second score therefore increases by 4.9 when Q c = 1 Q_{c}=1 ; when Q c = 0 Q_{c}=0 , both scores are zero.
blocks.zh: 一个例子说明,改变能见度标签会如何影响相机打分和选择。 所有其他标签和质量状态保持不变。 对于只有初级的可听取的标签,将其可见度从两个可见作用集中的缺席改为视觉初级,增加了4个初级-初级分红并取消了0.9个初级分罚。 因此,每秒得分在Q C = 1 = QQC = 1 = QC = 1 后增加4.9分;而当Q C = 0 = QC = 0 = 0.

blocks.en: Lower-tail aggregation and clipping at zero can leave the interval utility unchanged. The no-repeat rule also excludes the previous camera regardless of its score. For an eligible camera, normalisation depends on the utilities of the other eligible views: if it is the only view with positive utility, its probability remains one despite an increase in utility. Even when probabilities change, categorical sampling can return the same camera. These conditional effects distinguish label changes, score changes and camera choices; none alone establishes improved editorial quality.
blocks.zh: 更下尾的聚合和零分剪接可以使间隔工具不变. 不重复规则也排除了之前的相机,不管它的分数. 对于一个符合条件的相机,正常化取决于其他符合条件的视图的公用性:如果它是唯一具有正效用的视图,那么尽管公用性增加,它的概率仍然是一. 即使在概率变化时,断断续续的采样也可以返回同相机. 这些条件效应区分了标签的更改,分数的更改和相机的选择;没有哪一个能单独确立更好的编辑质量.
